newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight market sees some new orders.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight market sees some new orders.

text.p: A few new orders were reported on the sugar freight market but fresh fixing was slow, brokers said.
Vitol were reported in for 12/14,000 bulk Brazil to Black Sea for Dec 2/6.
E.D & F.Man required 12,250 bulk Maputo to Portugal for early December and 20,000 bulk Paranagua to Morocco, Egypt or Black Sea for Nov 15/28.
Jean Lion were looking for space for 3,000/4,000 bagged Continent to Algeria prompt.
